note: Per-board documents in the shape of site/data/community_board_budget_register/<board>.json. Cases marked real are copied unchanged from that register at the acquisition above; cases marked synthetic change one named property of a real request so a failure path has a fixture. Used by test/community_board_request_signals.test.mjs only.

with_response.what: DOE capital request with the answer published in both servable publications; a later diagnostic-only publication carries a different answer and must not be read

dycd_staten_island.what: DYCD expense request in the smallest borough

dep_bronx.what: DEP expense request in the Bronx

agency_unbound.what: the responsible agency is a public library the register cannot bind to an agency id, so no signal and no guess

agency_not_published.what: a Parks request: a bound agency the product does not publish; counted, not published

request_text_missing.what: a Sanitation request whose request text the publisher left empty; no text to carry, so no signal

explanation_null.what: a DEP request whose explanation is null; the row omits the field instead of carrying null

without_response.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a new tracking code and the servable response emptied
without_response.what: a DOE request whose servable publications carry no response text: the row says response_state not_published and carries no response

board_out_of_range.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_out_of_range.what: board_id 'queens-cb-15' is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_zero.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_zero.what: board_id 'queens-cb-00' is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_case.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_case.what: board_id 'Queens-CB-12' is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_wrong_borough_range.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_wrong_borough_range.what: board_id 'brooklyn-cb-19' is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_unknown_borough.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_unknown_borough.what: board_id 'newark-cb-01' is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_null.origin: synthetic: 412202701C with a malformed board id
board_null.what: board_id None is not one of the 59 community board ids; the request is excluded and counted, never repaired

board_not_bound.what: the register did not bind a board; excluded and counted

latest_servable_unbound.origin: synthetic: the older servable version names DOE, the latest servable version names an unbound institution
latest_servable_unbound.what: the latest servable publication decides; the older bound version is not borrowed

diagnostic_only.origin: synthetic: only the diagnostic-only publication remains
diagnostic_only.what: a publication dated after the read day is never the current answer

versions.request_title_derived: Complete funding to DSNY to develop and release of a RFP for the recently landmarked DSNY building at 128 West 17th S...
versions.explanation: Complete funding to DSNY to develop and release of a RFP for the recently landmarked DSNY building at 128 West 17th Street, aka, Former Colored School No 4. The recently landmarked building at 128 West 17th Street is a communal asset, and the way to commemorate its legacy is to bring life back to the building. We request that DSNY, with input from CB4 and other stakeholders, issue an RFP with the goal of soliciting proposals for the space that, among other things, commit to telling the story of Former Colored School No 4.
versions.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency supports and can accommodate Explanation: DSNY will continue moving forward with this project.

location.street: 128 WEST 17 STREET, New York, NY, USA
